mapper.sql: sys12_calendar_id AS calendar_id, sys12_company_id AS company_id, sys12_day::date AS day, sys12_weekday AS weekday, COALESCE(sys12_working_yn = 'true', false) AS working_yn, sys12_off_reason AS off_reason, sys12_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT , NULL AS company_nm FROM sys12_calendar WHERE sys12_calendar_id = #{calendarId}

SELECT , NULL AS company_nm FROM sys12_calendar WHERE sys12_company_id = #{companyId} AND to_char(sys12_day,'yyyy') = #{year} AND ( (#{month} != '%' AND to_char(sys12_day,'MM') = #{month}) OR (#{month} = '%') ) ORDER BY sys12_day

SELECT , sys01_company_nm AS company_nm FROM sys12_calendar INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = sys12_company_id WHERE 1=1 AND sys12_company_id != 0 AND sys12_day = #{day}::timestamp AND sys01_use_yn = 'true' ORDER BY sys01_company_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys12_calendar (sys12_calendar_id, sys12_company_id, sys12_day, sys12_weekday, sys12_working_yn, sys12_off_reason, sys12_note) SELECT f_create_seq() , company_id , dt , CASE to_char(dt, 'D') WHEN '1' THEN '일요일' WHEN '2' THEN '월요일' WHEN '3' THEN '화요일' WHEN '4' THEN '수요일' WHEN '5' THEN '목요일' WHEN '6' THEN '금요일' WHEN '7' THEN '토요일' END , CASE to_char(dt, 'D') WHEN '1' THEN 'false' WHEN '7' THEN 'false' ELSE ( CASE WHEN sys14_holiday_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END ) END , sys14_holiday_nm , '' FROM ( SELECT #{companyId}::numeric AS company_id , generate_series(to_date(#{year} || '0101','yyyymmdd'), to_date(#{year} || '1231','yyyymmdd'), '1 day'::interval)::date AS dt ) a LEFT OUTER JOIN sys14_holiday ON ( sys14_company_id = company_id AND sys14_day = dt )
